title: S54 — word-level reader over v7b-class nets: jointly-normalised whole-word crops + fusion-surviving segmentation
desc: Why: the measured evidence chain now fully closes patch-level integration on the glyph-CNN lane: S43 (segmentation owns 63/77 = 82% of residue, decision-tree census), S30/v7b read-level (net alone: hard exact 6->7), S31 (slot-swap -3/+1; context windows neutral-to-harmful; both NO-GO, PR #72), S51 (CLAHE NO-SHIP, PR #70). The remaining CNN-lane hypothesis: a reader whose units are WORDS, not glyphs - jointly normalised whole-word crops (advances-vs-ink semantics fixed once), with segmentation designed to survive fusion on the five wall families (collage/corrosion/cross-shadow/darts/strippy). Scope draft: (1) whole-word crop extraction protocol + truth alignment from the S53 corpus char_boxes (merges adjacent boxes per word); (2) word-image model candidates sized to the corpus (2000 items, in-domain augmentation budget named); (3) held-out protocol: canonical seed-1/seed-2 EVAL-ONLY at read level, corpus split by item; dev decisions on corpus only; (4) success bar named before training: shipping-route hard exact gain vs settled 23/100 with zero easy regression (73/100 floor), plus per-family table; honest-no report if missed. Depends on: PR #72 (evidence), S53 corpus (data), v7b lineage (init optional). Open for coordinator routing; barry can take it if assigned (matcher/rerank/post-processing lane + receipts rig already warm).
